'''Farabi Petrochemicals Group''' is a [[petrochemicals]] company based in [[Saudi Arabia]]. It is the world's largest producer of [[n-paraffin]] and [[linear alkylbenzene]] (LAB) globally.<ref name="au">{{cite web |title=About |url=https://farabipc.com/en/about-us |website=farabipc.com |access-date=22 August 2023}}</ref>

The Farabi Group consists of several companies including: '''Farabi Petrochemicals Company (FPC)''', '''Farabi Yanbu Petrochemicals Company (FYPC)''', Farabi Downstream Company (FDC), HADAF International Energy Company (HADAF), and Farabi Marketing Company (FMC). These companies are located in [[Jubail]] and [[Yanbu]] industrial cities of KSA.<ref name="an1">{{cite web |title=Farabi starts investments in China |url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/2326381/corporate-news |website=Arab News |language=en |date=22 June 2023}}</ref>

Farabi currently operates two large-scale [[alkane]] plants and three large-scale LAB plants. Additionally, specialty oils and specialty chemicals plants are situated in Yanbu and Jubail industrial cities.<ref name="sg1">{{cite web |title=Farabi Petrochemicals wins ‘Best Environmental Performer’ among Jubail Primary Industries for third consecutive year |url=https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/621578/BUSINESS/Farabi-Petrochemicals-wins-Best-Environmental-Performer-among-Jubail-Primary-Industries-for-third-consecutive-year |website=Saudigazette |language=English |date=9 June 2022}}</ref>

In 2023, Farabi completed a deal to acquire 50 percent of shares in Great Orient Chemical Pte. Ltd.<ref name=:1>{{cite news|title=Farabi starts investments in China|url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/2326381/corporate-news|work=Arab News}}</ref>
